## Summary

**Issue:** `checkout-api` was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Service status showed v2.3.1 deployed to us-east, us-west, and eu-west, all unhealthy. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed), so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" documenting the failure and the rollback.

**Final state:** `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002. Incident INC-0001 is open and tracked.
